name: event_bus
description: Publish-subscribe event bus connecting all AIOS modules. Events are typed by AIOS-EVENT-NNNNNN IDs (see UNIVERSAL-IDS.md). Subscribers register a module + handler for an event type; the bus delivers in registration order, synchronously within a tick. Failed handlers do not block the kernel (Law 9, Law 16).

outputs.name: delivered
outputs.description: Number of subscribers reached for a publish action.

side_effects: Writes every published event to the append-only event log (memory module) for audit
Handler exceptions are caught and logged; the bus continues (Law 9)

error_codes.message: A subscriber handler raised an exception.
error_codes.recovery: Log the exception + source module; mark the subscriber degraded; continue delivery to the next subscriber.

error_codes.message: Event type has no declared AIOS-EVENT schema.
error_codes.recovery: Reject the publish; advise operator to register the event type.

examples: publish(AIOS-EVENT-000003 phase_completed) -> delivered=N to all lifecycle observers.
